citation: Indotermes Roonwal, 1958: 81–82 [generic name made available in Roonwal, 1958, who states that the authors of the new taxon are Roonwal and Sen-Sarma, and gives their list of characters purporting to differentiate this taxon from others (characters are given at family- level, but family and genus are monotypic, so characters apply at all levels)].
